# LiveRegion

Use `LiveRegion` to announce dynamic content changes to screen readers without
moving focus. It satisfies **WCAG 4.1.3 Status Messages (Level AA)**.

## Usage

```jsx
import { LiveRegion } from '@adobe-commerce/elsie/components';
```

## The always-mounted rule

The most important constraint: **`LiveRegion` must always be rendered — never
conditionally mounted.**

Browsers and assistive technology only fire live region announcements when the
_content_ of an already-mounted region changes. Mounting a region with content
already inside it produces no announcement.

```tsx
// ✅ Correct — LiveRegion is always in the DOM; only its message toggles.
<LiveRegion message={loading ? 'Loading order summary' : ''} />;
{
  loading && <ProgressSpinner />;
}

// ❌ Wrong — mounting the region with content triggers no announcement.
{
  loading && <LiveRegion message="Loading…" />;
}
```

## All props

<Controls of={LiveRegionStories.LiveRegion} />

## Polite (default)

Screen readers finish the current sentence before reading the status message.
Use this for non-urgent updates like result counts, loading states, and
confirmations.

<Canvas of={LiveRegionStories.Polite} />

## Assertive

Interrupts the screen reader immediately. Reserve for time-sensitive errors or
failures that require immediate user attention.

<Canvas of={LiveRegionStories.Assertive} />

## Loading pattern

Pair `LiveRegion` with a visual loading indicator. The region stays mounted;
only its `message` prop changes.

<Canvas of={LiveRegionStories.LoadingPattern} />

## Empty (silent)

When `message` is an empty string the region is present in the DOM but announces
nothing. Use this to silence a previous announcement once the operation
completes and the result is already visible on screen.

<Canvas of={LiveRegionStories.Empty} />
